BulletPoints: Great Company | Established Team | Supportive Leadership

Variety in Role - Bored is not in our Vocab over here!

List.PayBenefits: Great Hourly Rate | Stable Hours | Train & Grow
List.Company: Family Owned Group | North Canterbury Specialists
List.Body: Are you hard working, job proud and like to be constantly moving? This family owned and operated market leader in North Canterbury could be for you!
List.ExtendedBody:
We’re looking for a solid, reliable Concrete Labourer to join a well-established, family-owned business that has been delivering quality workmanship across Canterbury for more than 24 years.

This isn’t just driveway work — our projects are varied, hands-on, and spread across rural, commercial, agricultural, and civil sites throughout North Canterbury and Christchurch. One day you could be working on dairy farm upgrades or shed construction, the next on culvert units, precast concrete, drainage projects, or large-scale in situ pours.

We’re a small, hardworking team with a strong reputation built on honesty, high standards, and repeat clients — and we’re looking for the right person to become part of it, for the long term.

What’s on offer:
•	Stable, long-term work with plenty happening 
•	Huge variety of projects and sites 
•	Supportive family-owned business that understands work/life balance 
•	Opportunity to gain licences and grow your skills (WTR, Class 2/4 etc.) 
•	Learn from an experienced operator with 30+ years in the industry 
•	Weekly pay 
•	Good gear, vehicles, PPE, and equipment supplied 
•	Real opportunity to grow with the business for the right person 

What we’re looking for:
•	Reliable and punctual — ready to start before the clock says go 
•	Strong work ethic and good attitude 
•	Honest, trustworthy, and able to communicate well 
•	Can follow instructions and work safely unsupervised when needed 
•	Someone who takes pride in doing things properly 
•	Full Class 1 license required 
•	Must be able to pass drug and alcohol testing 
•	WTR, machinery experience, or Class 2/ 4 are a bonus — but not essential
 
The role:
•	Based near Rangiora 
•	Typically, 40–50 hours per week 
•	7am starts generally, but flexibility is important in the concrete game 
•	Some early starts and occasional later finishes depending on pours and site requirements 
•	Mix of team-based and independent work across multiple sites 

This team values good people, good communication, and hard work. Respect is earned, effort is recognized, and there’s genuine flexibility for the right person who wants to be part of a great family business with a strong future ahead.

If you’re looking for a role where no two weeks are the same and want to work with a crew that backs quality workmanship and loyalty — we’d love to hear from you.

This role is a full time and permanent one and is the sort of position that can really set the right person up for a stable and long serving career - so please do reach out today and let's chat if this could suit you! 

Immediate Start Available for the right person! 

Please contact Emily @ EPIC Recruitment - emily@epicrecruitment.co.nz  or text/ call  027 2466464 with some info about yourself to set up a time to chat. 

Please note you must have full NZ working rights with no restrictions to be considered for this position.

List.Title: Specialist Operator - Grader

BulletPoints: Join our friendly, supportive crew where ideas count and good work is valued.
Build your future with training, clear career pathways, and great employee benef
Take pride in hands-on grader work that keeps road projects on track and safe.

List.Instructions: Please click Apply Now to apply for this role or to register your interest.
List.Body: Join us as a Specialist Grader Operator and do good work with a solid crew, high standards, and a sharp focus on safety.
List.ExtendedBody:
**Mo te turanga | About the role**

We're looking for an experienced Grader Operator to join our team and help deliver good work across our projects. This is a hands-on role for someone who knows how to get the job done safely, efficiently, and to a high standard.

You'll be trusted to operate grading plant professionally, support the wider site crew, and keep work moving to plan. It's a role for someone who takes pride in doing solid work, and backs their team

**Nga tino kawenga mahi | Key role responsibilitie**

* Operate the grader safely and efficiently to support road construction and maintenance works.
* Complete pre-starts, plant checks, and basic maintenance before machinery is operated.
* Follow the work programme and site instructions from your supervisor or foreperson to keep delivery on track.
* Take safety seriously by speaking up, using stay safe questions, and reporting incidents, near misses, and hazards.
* Look for smarter, safer ways of working and contribute to a team culture built on respect, reliability, and good work.

**Kei te kimi matou i tetahi e whai ana i enei pukenga | We're looking for someone with**

* A current Class 4 driver licence essential.
* W, T, R endorsements essential.
* Proven construction grading experience, ideally building new roads.
* Traffic controller certification or experience desirable but not essential.
* A strong focus on safety, quality, and doing the job right the first time.
* A reliable, practical, team-focused approach with a willingness to learn and get stuck in.

**He pai te mahi, he pai nga painga | Good work, good benefits**

At Fulton Hogan, we genuinely care about the wellbeing of our people and giving them the tools and opportunities they need to succeed and grow with us. You'll have access to:

* Medical insurance and Life insurance after the eligibility period.
* KiwiSaver employer contributions after service milestones, up to 7%.
* Parental leave top up payment with additional return to work support.
* Ongoing training and development, with clear career growth and progression opportunities.
* Great discounts at a wide range of retailers.

**Ko wai matou | About us**

At Fulton Hogan, good work is what we do and how we do it. We're friendly, and forward moving. Titles matter less than ideas, and we back our people to speak up, step up, and keep growing.

We take the work seriously, not ourselves. That means a team that looks out for each other, keeps standards high, and shares a laugh along the way. If you want to be part of a crew that values safety, low ego, and getting stuck in, you'll fit right in here.

**Me pehea te tono | How to apply**

If you're an experienced Grader Operator who values safety, takes pride in your work, and wants to be part of a good crew doing good work, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and bring your skills to Fulton Hogan **.**

List.Title: Support Worker -Waipukurau - Part-Time - Evening
List.Body: Support workers |?Kaiawhina?make a meaningful, positive impact on clients' quality of life every day in the clients' own homes
List.ExtendedBody:
Looking for a role that works around your life? 

Whether you're balancing study, family, or other commitments, we may be able to accommodate your availability based on the care needs in our community. 
You'll support tangata with their individual care needs and daily living activities — no qualifications or prior experience required. Your role is to provide safe, respectful, person centered support in people's homes, including being mindful of what matters to them, their culture, values, beliefs, routines, and boundaries.

* Comprehensive paid training to set you up for success 
* Weekend shifts available (+$1.00 extra per hour) 
* Paid travel time and mileage —When you travel for work, we make sure you're compensated fairly — including paid travel time and mileage for longer trips. Full details will be shared during onboarding. 

This is a great opportunity to gain valuable experience in the health and wellbeing sector while keeping your work-life balance in check. 

Whakangungu | Training 

Paid training! Our Kaiawhina Skills Framework training takes place during your first two-four weeks of employment and includes: 

* Support through structured induction, ongoing training, refreshers, and clear development pathways.    
* Online self-directed learning 
* Working alongside a buddy trainer 

Mohou Ake | About You 

* Love working with people and helping them thrive 
* Intuitive and responsive to people's needs 
* Committed to culturally safe, respectful support for people from all backgrounds 
* Willing to learn, reflect, and adapt your approach to what matters to each person 
* Own a smartphone 
* Have the right to work in New Zealand 
* Full/restricted driver's license   

He aha ai matou? | Why Us 

* Flexible hours - mornings, evenings, weekends 
* $24.33-$30.27 plus weekend allowances 
* A clear career pathway for Kaiawhina | Support Workers 
* Exclusive Spark Mobile Plan: Endless data (40GB at max speed), unlimited NZ/AU calls & texts, hotspot access, voicemail for just $24.15/month 
* Our work is grounded in Kaitiakitanga, Kotahitanga, Tu Tika and Manaakitanga — caring for our communities, working together, doing the right thing, and looking after each other 

Access Community Health | Uru Atea's mission is to create a better day, every day for thousands of people throughout Aotearoa, helping them live independently in their own homes and communities. Uru Atea means "to enter space"—our promise to deliver services wherever our clients need us.
